sentences.text: C O R A M : H O N ' B L E M R . J U S T I C E A N A N T B I J A Y S I N G H F o r t h e P e t i t i o n e r
: Mrs Rashmi Kumari, Advocate For the State : A.P.P. 02/ Dated 5 July, 2016 th

The petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Telaiya P.S. Case No. 
182 of 2015 registered under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 16(1
B) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that coaccused persons namely  Jageshwar Rajak, who is the President of village Education Committee and Meera Devi  is coordinator of the Mata Samiti was the responsible person for the care of the food  given to the children, who have been granted bail by this Court in B.A. Nos. 8408 of  2015 and 1010 of 2016, respectively.
She also submits that petitioner is not named in  the F.I.R.
He further submits that petitioner is in custody since 4.6.2016.
L e a r n e d c o u n s e l f o r t h e S t a t e o p p o s e s t h e p r a y e r f o r b a i l .
Regard being had to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to  release the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named is directed to be  released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/ (Rupees Ten Thousand) with  two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M, Koderma in  connection with Telaiya P.S. Case No. 182 of 2015 corresponding to G.R. No. 830 of 2015.

(A.B.Singh, J.) Anjali /
